subheading: INVESTIGATIONS OF INTRA-HEPATIC CHOLESTATIC JAUNDICE OF PREGNANCY
subheading_corrected: Investigations of Intra-Hepatic Cholestatic Jaundice of Pregnancy
text:
INVESTIGATIONS OF INTRA-HEPATIC CHOLESTATIC JAUNDICE OF PREGNANCY
Investigations
- Bilirubinuria
- Elevated bile acids
- Elevated alkaline phosphatase
- Elevated liver transferase enzymes
- Prothrombin time
- Always exclude viral disease, gallstones and treatment with chlorpromazine
